notes: Fiberglass tanks: 50 psi working pressure, hydrostatically tested to 1.1x working pressure, 4:1 safety factor.
Steel SRF/DRF: 50 psi operating, 75 psi hydrostatic test.
Sand .45-.55 mm, 100 lb per cu ft. Gravel 1/4 x 1/8 in where used.

models.note: From drawing 36CCFG-3MAN (FP-1). NSF PIF lists 6.9 sq ft and a 16 in bed; tech data sheet ML-4/29/26 lists 42 and 48 only.

ops.3WL: 3-way lever: valve pairs linked to one handle (influent with backwash waste, effluent with backwash supply)
ops.3WE: 3-way electric: linear actuators on the linked valve pairs (115/220 V)
ops.3WP: 3-way pneumatic: pneumatic operators driven by an MFP4 programmer
ops.STD: Standard face piping with individual valves
ops.DLK: DLK face piping (as listed in the master product list)
